name: My Vampire Catboy Romance
source:
Embark on a [b]soul-touching[/b] adventure to meet the vampire catboy of your dreams, build [b]deep connections[/b] and learn [b]things[/b] about yourself you didn't know before.

[From [url=https://glueblade.itch.io/my-vampire-catboy-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏上一段[b]触动灵魂[/b]的冒险之旅，遇见你梦想中的吸血鬼猫童，建立[b]深厚的联系[/b]，并了解你以前不了解的[b]事情[/b]。

[来自[url=https://glueblade.itch.io/my-vampire-catboy-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
